kind: ephemeral local Candid reply decoding; no persisted product record

methods.list_canister_snapshots: exactly one vector of 0..1024 snapshot descriptors

descriptor.id: required blob; 1..256 opaque raw bytes, unchanged
descriptor.taken_at_timestamp: required nat64; full range in nanoseconds
descriptor.total_size: required nat64; declared snapshot size, not local artifact bytes

admission.sequence_bounds: bounded visitors reject untrusted lengths without preallocating from them
admission.tuple: one argument; required exact field types; no skipped fields, extra arguments or trailing bytes
admission.identity: sort inventory by exact raw ID bytes; duplicate IDs reject even with changed metadata
admission.diagnostics: no raw response bytes or decoder prose in public errors

hashing.payload: SHA-256 of exact raw reply bytes, preserving wire order
hashing.body: existing request digest then raw payload checksum, each 64 lowercase ASCII hex bytes
hashing.request: existing canonical request owner binds method, management receiver, routing target, replicated ingress and exact arguments
hashing.authority: local declared association only; the wire has no target/network/caller/challenge or application operation identity

golden_registry.membership: every registered fixture entry is checked by the production decoder and official SDK DTO decoder
golden_registry.construction: independent DIDL/field-hash/LEB128/nat64 assembly and SHA-256 calculation

qualification.native: exact bytes, metadata, finite bounds, duplicate/shape rejection, canonical projection, request/reply hashing and spent-journal reopen
qualification.unchanged_on_decode: original intent, mutation/observation spending, pending states, retained evidence and obligations
integration_owned: fresh permission and original per-call spending
capture settlement under competing controllers and lost responses
complete metadata/data extents and verified transfer
application fencing/restore safety and actual IC backend qualification
qualification.grants: no signing, dispatch, fresh spending, Applied receipt, retry, completion or reference release
